proposal.chemistry_notes: The batch transformation is Pd(OH)2/Al2O3-catalyzed hydrogenolysis of N-diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol in methanol at 60 C, optionally promoted by acetic acid. Hydrogen is an essential stoichiometric reagent for this chemistry. Acetic acid may affect rate/selectivity but cannot replace hydrogen. The reported 38.1% batch yield does not provide a basis for selecting a liquid-only continuous-flow condition.
